name: 70611 · Lake Charles, LA
findings: ZIP 70611 (Lake Charles) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70611 (Lake Charles) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
